# PLAN — iteration 2
## Current state assessment
Iteration 1 is the verified best at 22 LUTs with timing met (WNS 0.69 ns, WHS 0.149 ns), so iteration 2 must strictly reduce LUT use while passing every simulation, routed-report, timing, and promotion gate. The editable top has a known latency of 1 and must retain `// @latency 1`; its fixed `DIV=868` schedule and registered outputs remain unchanged.

## Hypothesis
Replacing the indexed `data_reg[bit_index]` selection with a shifting byte register should remove the 8-to-1 data mux and reduce LUT use, while using the existing data flops and counter logic.

## Instruction for generator
In the busy bit-boundary logic, replace the variable-index read `data_reg[bit_index]` with `data_reg[0]`, and shift the captured byte toward bit 0 on each data-bit boundary so bits are still transmitted least-significant first. Keep the existing `bit_index` and `bit_count` frame timing, and ensure shifting occurs only after the old bit 0 is used; preserve the stop bit, completion edge, reset values, and all registered output behavior. Retain the top interface and matching latency annotation, then compare routed LUTs against the 22-LUT verified best under the same constraints.
